---
title: "`pi_score()` — significance × effect size"
---

## Purpose

Add a π-score column that ranks proteins by **both** statistical significance
and fold-change magnitude, instead of a p-value (which ignores effect size) or a
fold-change (which ignores noise).

## When to use

Whenever you want a single ordering for volcano colouring or hit selection that
rewards large, confident changes. Used by `enrich_volcano(p_method = "pi_eq2")`
for the volcano significance call.

## How it works

For each protein with p-value $P$ and $\log_2$ fold-change:

$$\pi_{eq2} = P^{|\log_2 FC|} \qquad \pi_{eq1} = |\log_2 FC|\cdot(-\log_{10}P)$$

The two are monotone-equivalent — $-\log_{10}(\pi_{eq2}) = \pi_{eq1}$ — so a
cutoff of `eq2 < 0.05` is identical to `eq1 > 1.301`. `eq2` lives on the
familiar [0,1] p-scale (smaller = stronger); `eq1` is unbounded (larger =
stronger).

::: {.callout-important}
π-score is **unsigned** and must not be used as a GSEA ranking statistic — it
collapses the ranked list to one tail. `ev_enrich()` rejects it. Rank by the
moderated `t` instead.
:::

## Parameters & defaults

| Argument | Default | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"eq2"` | p-scale form; reported significance call |
| `p_col` | `"P.Value"` | limma/proteoDA p-value column |
| `logfc_col` | `"logFC"` | canonical effect-size column |
| `out_col` | `pi_<variant>` | non-destructive: adds a column |

## Literature

- Xiao Y, *et al.* "A novel significance score for gene selection and ranking."
  *Bioinformatics* 2014;30(6):801–7. PMID:22321699.

## Example

```r
res <- pi_score(dep, variant = "eq2")   # adds pi_eq2 = P.Value^|logFC|
sum(res$pi_eq2 < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
```
